text:
When a job closes with state stale, queue the request "try again on <job id>" automatically, at the stale job's priority, so the existing stale-merge path in run/mod.rs reuses the kept candidate. Today close.rs only prints a hint to run athena retry. Queue at most one automatic retry per job: if that retry goes stale too, print the hint as today and queue nothing more. Acceptance: (1) a test where a job closes stale shows exactly one queued request that cites it, at the same priority; (2) a test shows a stale retry of a stale job queues nothing more; (3) the job report lists the November stale jobs that still have no retry (20261107-224504-k8mh, 20261108-063602-h7je, 20261108-110309-qbwe, 20261108-142640-egnb, 20261108-224527-qhtc, 20261109-083730-kznz, 20261113-073013-c3eb, 20261114-052244-qf6e), so the the person running Athena can retry them; (4) a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Jobs that close stale are never retried: 8 of 11 stale jobs in November have no retry, including an owner request that passed its final verdict
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: run/mod.rs, close.rs, CHANGELOG.md
